Class Camera.Builder

java.lang.Object
renderer.Camera.Builder
Enclosing class:
Camera
public static class Camera.Builder extends Object
Fluent builder for Camera.

All configuration is set here; the resulting Camera instance returned by build() is effectively immutable (the clone isolates it from the builder's internal camera object).

    • setMultithreading

      public Camera.Builder setMultithreading(int threads)
      Configures the multi-threading rendering mode.

      Parameter semantics:

      • -2 – raw threads, count set to availableProcessors() − SPARE_THREADS
      • -1 – Java parallel stream (JVM chooses thread count)
      • 0 – single-threaded (default)
      • ≥1 – raw threads, exactly this many
      Parameters:
      threads - threading mode / explicit thread count
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if threads is less than -2

      Returns:

    • setAntiAliasing

      public Camera.Builder setAntiAliasing(int numSamples)
      Enables and configures anti-aliasing super-sampling.

      Each pixel is sampled at numSamples different positions inside its area; the resulting colors are averaged. Pass 1 (or omit this call) to disable anti-aliasing and use a single central ray.

      Recommended values: 9 (3×3) for drafts, 81 (9×9) for demos, 289–1089 (17×17–33×33) for final renders.

      Parameters:
      numSamples - number of sample rays per pixel (must be ≥ 1)
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if numSamples is less than 1

    • setApertureSize

      public Camera.Builder setApertureSize(double size)
      Sets the radius of the simulated aperture window for depth-of-field blur.

      Objects on the focal plane (set by setFocalDistance(double)) appear sharp; objects at other depths are blurred proportionally to their distance from the plane. A larger aperture produces stronger blur. Pass 0 (or omit this call) to keep the pinhole camera model.

      Parameters:
      size - aperture radius in world units (must be ≥ 0; 0 = disabled)
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if size is negative

    • setFocalDistance

      public Camera.Builder setFocalDistance(double distance)
      Sets the focal distance for depth-of-field rendering.

      This is the distance from the camera along vTo to the focal plane. Objects on the focal plane appear sharp.

      Parameters:
      distance - focal plane distance in world units (must be positive)
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if distance is not positive

    • setDofNumSamples

      public Camera.Builder setDofNumSamples(int numSamples)
      Sets the number of aperture sample points used per pixel for depth-of-field. More samples produce a smoother blur at the cost of longer render times.
      Parameters:
      numSamples - aperture sample count (must be ≥ 1)
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if numSamples is less than 1
